paper_title: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways

claims.statement: In a memorization analysis using 50-token prompts, the 8B PaLM model exactly reproduced 50-token continuations for 1.6% of training data, while the 540B model reproduced them for 2.4% of the data.

evidence.quote: We can see that the 8B model was able to exactly reproduce the 50 token continuation for 1.6% of the data, while the 540B model was able to reproduce the continuation for 2.4% of the data.
